input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
input.rationale: Paragraph 4(a) auto-renews for successive 1-year terms with no non-renewal mechanic. The only for-any-reason exit requires ninety (90) days' notice and is available only "following the Initial Term", so the first renewal cannot be avoided and thereafter the effective exit window is 90 days, failing the fallback element of a non-renewal notice window of no more than 60 days (the 12-month renewal term is not walk-away multi-year). We therefore insert a Customer-only right to decline renewal on at least 60 days' written notice, leaving the mutual termination, breach and insolvency rights untouched. Renewal occurs on existing terms with no price-increase mechanic (fees are a revenue share under an Exhibit), so the conditional 5% uplift cap is untriggered. Moving the window to 30 days and adding a Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal would reach the preferred position.

proposal.summary: Add a 60 days' non-renewal notice right for Customer to the auto-renewal mechanic
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement auto-renews for successive 1-year terms with no non-renewal mechanic, so our only exit is the 90 days' notice right available after the Initial Term. We have added a Customer right to decline renewal on 60 days' written notice, which is our fallback position (non-renewal window of no more than 60 days); renewal pricing is unchanged, so no uplift cap is needed.

ops.oldText: The initial term of this Agreement shall be one (1) year from the Effective Date (the "Initial Term"). This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term").
ops.newText: The initial term of this Agreement shall be one (1) year from the Effective Date (the "Initial Term"). This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless Customer gives written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days prior to the end of the then-current term, or earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term").

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
